title: Software Engineering Intern, 3D & Manufacturing Applications
summary:
ABOUT VALSTAD
Valstad is building the machine that builds the ships.
We combine industrial robotics, welding, sensing, and AI to turn 3D models into real high-mix ship structure. Our mission is to rapidly expand America's maritime output by 100x.
Our team works directly with large industrial robots and real manufacturing equipment at our Austin facility. The systems we build will ultimately be deployed across shipyards and industrial facilities throughout the country.
ABOUT VALSTAD
Valstad is rebuilding how ships are made.
American shipbuilding is constrained by slow, labor-intensive production methods and a shortage of skilled manufacturing capacity. We are developing robotic production systems that can turn engineering data directly into finished steel structures, dramatically reducing the time and manual programming required to build ships.
Our first platform combines industrial robots, automated material handling, welding, sensing and AI-driven manufacturing software to produce large ship panels and structural assemblies. Instead of programming each new part by hand, our goal is for the system to understand the CAD model, determine how the structure should be assembled and welded, and generate the robotic plan required to build it.
This requires software that allows engineers and operators to understand complex 3D structures, review automatically generated manufacturing plans, control production workflows and respond when physical conditions differ from the nominal CAD model.
The software you build will be used to manufacture real steel structures in our Austin facility and, over time, in shipyards across the country.
THE INTERNSHIP
Valstad is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to help build interactive 3D and manufacturing applications for our robotic production platform.
You will work with CAD-derived geometry, robot paths, manufacturing data and factory workflows. Depending on your experience and interests, your project may involve 3D visualization,...

Firetiger is on a mission to help our customers build 1-person, $1 billion revenue companies.
We believe that eventually, all companies will be software companies, and the vast majority of coordination will be handled by autonomous agents, not people. To get there, we are helping software companies become "self-driving".
Legacy software engineering operations software is built for humans to manually explore data and patch together brittle alerts. The last generation of tools like Datadog is designed to enable humans to understand how software behaves. Firetiger flips the script. We approach operations from first principles: customers define top-down what success looks like for a business and product, then deploy agents to constantly monitor to ensure those goals are met and close the loop.
We are founded by Rustam http://linkedin.com/in/lalkaka and Achille https://www.linkedin.com/in/achille-roussel/, former leaders from Cloudflare and Segment, and backed by Sequoia Capital and founders and executives at Cloudflare, Segment, Amazon, Anthropic, Cursor, and Plaid.

1. We ingest telemetry with high-cardinality detail and automatically model what your system is and how it works

3. Agents autonomously investigate issues, determine root cause, and take action to remediate
